name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), set the API key from the sandbox environment variable, and made a chat completions API call to Fireworks using the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The response "Hello in Spanish is **¡Hola!**" was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I deviated by querying the `/v1/models` endpoint to discover available models and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p1`, which succeeded. All other steps (OpenAI SDK, base_url, env var auth, code structure) followed the docs exactly.
